name: FourierFilter
label: Fourier Filter
description: Filter the dataset in Fourier (reciprocal) space: FFT, multiply by a radial filter, inverse FFT. Distances are in frequency bins from the center of the fftshift-ed spectrum. Low pass keeps frequencies inside the cutoff radius, high pass keeps those outside, and band pass keeps a shell centered on the cutoff radius.

parameters.name: filter_type
parameters.label: Filter Type
parameters.description: Low pass keeps low frequencies (smooths), high pass keeps high frequencies (edges/detail), band pass keeps a spherical shell of frequencies around the cutoff radius.

parameters.name: cutoff
parameters.label: Cutoff Radius (bins)
parameters.description: Radius in frequency bins from the spectrum center. For low/high pass this is the cutoff; for band pass it is the center radius of the shell.

parameters.name: width
parameters.label: Width (bins)
parameters.description: For low/high pass, the edge softness (0 for a hard cutoff). For band pass, the width of the shell.

parameters.name: band_profile
parameters.label: Band Profile
parameters.description: Radial profile of the band-pass shell (only used for band pass): Gaussian exp(-(d-r0)^2/w^2), a single Hann lobe, a hard rectangle, or a soft rectangle with a one-bin erf edge.

parameters.name: dimensionality
parameters.label: Dimensionality
parameters.description: Apply one 3D filter to the whole volume, or apply the same 2D filter to every slice perpendicular to the chosen axis.

parameters.name: slice_axis
parameters.label: Slice Axis (2D mode)
parameters.description: Axis perpendicular to the slices in 2D mode.
